context.self_correction_note: Two bugs caught in my own first draft while writing the new tests (not in the shipped implementation): (1) Definitions.deprecate/2 and archive/2 return {:ok, %ProcessDefinition{}} directly, unlike activate/2's {:ok, %{definition: _}} -- my first pattern match was wrong. (2) A HUMAN_TASK node's 'role' attribute is mandatory (graph validation CHK-09), so an engine-created task's assignee_ref is never nil straight off dispatch -- Tasks.assign_task/3's own first-assignment precondition (%Task{assignee_ref: nil}) is unreachable via the ordinary create path. Fixed by forcing the row to that state via a direct Repo.update_all/2 before calling assign_task/3 for real, the same class of adversarial-state technique audit_test.exs's own AC6 tests already use (bypassing the immutability trigger via raw SQL) to exercise a state the normal write path cannot produce.
